skill.name: azure-validate
skill.description: Pre-deployment validation for Azure applications. It checks deployment plans, infrastructure files, authentication, policy readiness, and recipe-specific prerequisites before deployment.
skill.summary: Validate Azure deployment readiness before release.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown links, inline code formatting, and documented Azure validation commands. However, SKILL.md contains instruction-hierarchy override language and a mandatory deployment handoff that can manipulate downstream agents. Remove those directives before marketplace publication.

remediation.suggestion: Remove claims that the skill is authoritative or supersedes prior training. State that the skill guidance is subordinate to system, developer, and user instructions.
Replace the mandatory azure-deploy invocation with a user-controlled recommendation. Require explicit confirmation before any deployment workflow begins.
Clarify that the skill only reads and updates .azure/plan.md. Warn users not to include secrets or credential files in validation proof.

semantic_findings.title: Mandatory Deployment Handoff

content.value_statement: Azure deployments can fail late because prerequisites, policies, or infrastructure files are wrong. This skill runs structured preflight validation before release.
actual_capabilities: Reads the deployment plan to identify the selected Azure validation recipe.
Guides validation for Azure Developer CLI, Azure CLI, Bicep, and Terraform projects.
Checks Azure authentication, subscription, location, and environment readiness.
Validates infrastructure with preview, build, lint, plan, and policy checks.
Records validation proof and blocks progress when checks fail.
limitations: Does not create or scaffold applications.
Does not execute deployments by itself.
Requires the relevant Azure, Bicep, Terraform, Docker, or azd tools to be available.
Depends on valid project files and authenticated Azure access.

use_cases.title: Check Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Run preflight checks before a planned Azure deployment and identify blockers early.

use_cases.title: Validate Infrastructure Changes
use_cases.description: Confirm Bicep or Terraform files compile, validate, and preview expected changes.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Failed Previews
use_cases.description: Map common azd, Bicep, Terraform, and policy errors to clear fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate My App
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate my Azure app before deployment. Check the current plan, run the required recipe checks, and summarize any blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Check Bicep Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this Azure deployment that uses Bicep. Check compilation, template validation, authentication, policy readiness, and region support.

prompt_templates.title: Review Terraform Preflight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the Terraform validation path for this Azure project. Confirm formatting, initialization, validation, state access, and policy readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Deployment Blockers
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the validation failures in this Azure project. Separate tool, configuration, policy, region, and authentication issues, then recommend fixes.

output_examples.input: Validate my azd project before deployment.
output: Authentication is valid, but the selected region does not support one planned service.
Next step: choose a supported region and rerun validation.

output_examples.input: Check whether my Bicep deployment is ready.
output: The template compiles and validation passes.
Review the policy warning before starting deployment.
Terraform syntax is valid, but the backend cannot be reached.
Fix backend credentials or network access, then rerun the preflight check.

best_practices: Confirm the Azure subscription and region with the user before validation.
Record every validation command and result in the deployment plan.
Resolve all failed checks before starting any deployment workflow.
anti_patterns: Marking a plan as validated without proof.
Running deployment commands from this validation skill.
Ignoring region, policy, or authentication errors because build checks pass.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It validates readiness and reports blockers before a separate deployment workflow.

faq.question: Which Azure project types does it support?
faq.answer: It covers azd, Azure CLI, Bicep, and Terraform validation paths.

faq.question: Does it require Azure authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. Several checks need an authenticated Azure account and a confirmed subscription.

faq.question: Can it validate Azure Policy requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes policy validation guidance and checks for compliance blockers.

faq.question: Can it fix validation errors automatically?
faq.answer: It can recommend fixes and guide corrections. Risky or destructive changes still require user confirmation.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production releases?
faq.answer: It is useful before production deployment, but teams should still follow their release controls.
